title: Remove rectangle element above tagline in Navbar header

requirements.text: In the Navbar component (frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx), remove the rectangle element (div, image, banner, or decorative block) that appears above the text 'Especialistas en Ciberseguridad · Reynosa, Tamaulipas' in the header.

quotes: es un rectangulo arriba de donde dice Especialistas en Ciberseguridad · Reynosa, Tamaulipas

acceptanceCriteria: The rectangle element no longer appears above the 'Especialistas en Ciberseguridad · Reynosa, Tamaulipas' text in the header.
The rest of the Navbar layout and content remains intact.
No visual gaps or broken layout are introduced where the rectangle was.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not alter any other sections or components beyond the Navbar header.
nonGoals: Modifying the Footer or any other sections.
Adding new elements to replace the removed rectangle.
